name: Kettlebell Figure 8
steps: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width in an athletic quarter-squat hip hinge, holding one kettlebell in your right hand with a flat back.
Pass the kettlebell backward between your legs from the front and receive it behind your left thigh with your left hand.
Bring the bell around your left thigh to the front, then pass it back to your right hand behind your right thigh.
Continue weaving the kettlebell in a smooth, alternating figure-eight pattern while keeping your hips low and spine neutral.
tips: Drive each pass slightly with your hips and core rather than rounding your lower back.
Keep your gaze forward and transfer the handle smoothly from hand to hand.
